data.long_meaning: Jenish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jenana', meaning 'graceful' or 'beautiful'. It is believed that this name was given to children born under auspicious circumstances and was considered a symbol of good fortune and blessings. The name Jenish carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jenish usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
